scope: Verify the CLI's strict default and explicit partial-read behavior on a locally authored DWG with one rejected entity frame followed by one valid entity.

control.sourceProfile: AC1027; generated from scratch by ReadOutcomeControl(kind=1), which writes a non-finite LINE followed by a valid LINE

cases.expect: the DWG operation returns success with entityParseFailures=1 and failed=1; strict export exits 1 and preserves a destination sentinel
warning states possible omissions and strict owner/reference checks; conversion exits 0 and publishes AC1027 ASCII DXF containing the one valid LINE
published DXF reopens through dwg2dxf with exactly one LINE; source and first output remain unchanged

validation.test: PASS: python3 -B tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --writer build-gcc/libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --partial-read-only (3 controls); ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R '^dwg2dxf_cli_contract$' --output-on-failure (1/1, 9.97 s)

limits: This tests one generated AC1027 entity parse failure, the strict/partial switch, and returned LINE readback. It does not qualify other source versions, multiple failure patterns, repair/skip projections, or owner/reference failures as partial-output eligible.
